reasons: The v1 campaign stopped every provider turn with invalid_json_schema before generation.
The v2 campaign captured complete token usage, but the AgentPlane arms received a PLANNER episode instead of the fixed implementation episode.
The v2 oracle and launcher parsed tracked porcelain output after trimming its leading status column, so the minimal arm's valid work/result.txt mutation was misclassified.
No v2 pair has equivalent independently verified outcomes across all three arms.
Further attempts would require a newly preregistered campaign and are not justified by the fixed pilot rule.
future_campaign_requirements: The AgentPlane arms must enter the fixed implementation episode instead of stopping after the PLANNER bootstrap.
The launcher and oracle must parse the two-character porcelain status column before normalizing the tracked path.
The corrected launcher, oracle, campaign order, and claim policy must be pinned before any new provider attempt.
A future campaign must use a new campaign identity and must not replace, omit, or retry any v1 or v2 attempt.
